heading: Wiring into libds
text:
### Wiring into libds [IRET.15.1]

The C Rete engine is one subsystem of `ds_engine_t`.
`ds_engine_new` creates it (`ds_rete_engine_create`,
stored as `engine->rete_engine`), registers the built-in
callable functions (`ds_register_builtins`), and calls
`ds_engine_wire_rete_adapters`, which populates the
engine's `ds_rete_adapter_config_t` with the action-verb
callbacks (log, call, publish, emit, cache). The Rete engine is libds's only rule-evaluation substrate,
and nothing selects it.

libds drives the engine through these entry points:

| libds operation | `ds_rete_*` entry point |
|---|---|
| Create engine | `ds_rete_engine_create(&rete_engine)` |
| Destroy engine | `ds_rete_engine_destroy(rete_engine)` |
| Load compiled network | `ds_rete_load(engine, atom bodies)` |
| Before-fire hook | `ds_rete_set_before_fire(engine, hook, ctx)` |
| After-fire hook | `ds_rete_set_after_fire(engine, hook, ctx)` |
| Assert a fact | `ds_rete_wm_assert(engine, …)` |
| Retract a fact | `ds_rete_wm_retract(engine, fact)` |
| Run the agenda | `ds_rete_run(engine, max_fires, fires_out)` |
| Register a callable | `ds_register_fn` / `ds_register_fn_rt` |
| Agenda ordering | built into the agenda (no API) |
